thread:
alexander: Heads up — during the 02:00 UTC change window we're seeing a p95 spike on /v1/generate for the embeddings route right after the canary shift. Dashboard: https://obs.redwood/boards/slo/embeds-p95

maria: saw that too. it's isolated to eu-west cluster?

alexander: yep eu-west primarily, p95 jumped from 120ms -> 480ms for ~10m, error rate stable. no 5xx.

jon: deploy-bot just started the canary at +10% about 12:34 UTC per the deployment log.

deploy-bot: deploy started: release=v3.5.4-canary, targets=[eu-west-embeds], step=10% -> 30% scheduled in 5m. CI: all green. :package:

kevin: can we check KV cache hit ratio? long sequences might be causing cache churn. link: https://obs.redwood/metrics/kvcache?cluster=eu-west

maria: KV cache hit looks fine. throughput increased and CPU on the embed workers jumped ~20%.

alexander: no obvious GC or OOM, but tail latency correlates with requests that have seq_len > 1024. suspect kernel fallback on those batches.

jon: suggestion: pause rollout at current weight and pin canary to previous model variant for eu-west while we debug. we can keep global rollout for other regions.

maria: agreed. pausing rollout now.

deploy-bot: pausing deploy: release=v3.5.4-canary, action=PAUSE, reason="p95 spike eu-west embeds".

kevin: quick mitigation option: enable routing policy to fallback to model v3.5.3 for requests with seq_len > 1024 until we root cause. small rule, low blast radius.

alexander: +1. how fast to pin? can we do a runtime route change?

maria: yes, routing policy update pushed. command we ran:
```
redwood route update --route embeds-eu-west --rule "if seq_len > 1024 -> model=v3.5.3" --priority=high
```

sre-bot: routing change detected by ops: route=embeds-eu-west, change=seq_len-fallback, author=maria, ts=6321987690.

jon: nice. canary weight remains at 10% for eu-west now. we'll continue probing at low traffic.

alexander: I'm going to add a note to the release notes and the changelog: "known p95 regression on long-sequence embeds in v3.5.4-canary; routing fallback applied for seq_len>1024 in eu-west."

maria: adding to release notes and opening a ticket to follow up with runtime infra to investigate kernel selection path. ticket: https://issues.redwood/RED-4821

kevin: also set an alert threshold to notify if p95 remains >300ms for more than 5m post-fallback.

sre-bot: alert rule updated: slo=embeds.p95, threshold=300ms, window=5m, notify=#eng-oncall.

alexander: we'll monitor for 20m. if long-tail persists despite fallback -> rollback to v3.5.3.

jon: ack. I'll coordinate rollback steps if needed and prepare a quick revert playbook in the thread.

maria: thanks all. small procedural note — add the fallback rule to the deploy ticket so Dedicated customers are aware of the temporary routing fix.

alexander: done. will update customer-facing release notes after we confirm stability. :white_check_mark:
